class Tenant(models.Model):
    slug = models.SlugField(unique=True)       # used as the subdomain
    name = models.CharField(max_length=200)
    is_active = models.BooleanField(default=True)
    created_at = models.DateTimeField(auto_now_add=True)

    def __str__(self):
        return self.name

items.title: Isolation test: manager scoping
items.body:
import pytest
from tenancy.context import tenant_context
from tenancy.models import Tenant


@pytest.fixture
def tenants(db):
    return Tenant.objects.create(slug="a", name="A"), Tenant.objects.create(slug="b", name="B")


def test_manager_isolates_rows(tenants):
    a, b = tenants
    with tenant_context(a):
        Invoice.objects.create(number="A-1")
    with tenant_context(b):
        Invoice.objects.create(number="B-1")
        assert list(Invoice.objects.values_list("number", flat=True)) == ["B-1"]
    with tenant_context(a):
        assert list(Invoice.objects.values_list("number", flat=True)) == ["A-1"]


def test_no_tenant_means_no_rows(tenants):
    with tenant_context(tenants[0]):
        Invoice.objects.create(number="A-1")
    assert Invoice.objects.count() == 0
items.description: Two tenants, same data shape; neither may see the other's rows.

items.title: Isolation test: API cannot cross tenants
items.body:
def test_api_isolation(tenants, api_client):
    a, b = tenants
    with tenant_context(a):
        inv = Invoice.objects.create(number="A-1")

    # list: B sees nothing
    r = api_client.get("/api/invoices/", HTTP_HOST="b.example.com")
    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["results"] == []

    # detail / update / delete by id: 404, not 403 (do not leak existence)
    for method in ("get", "patch", "delete"):
        r = getattr(api_client, method)(f"/api/invoices/{inv.pk}/", HTTP_HOST="b.example.com")
        assert r.status_code == 404
# settings needs ALLOWED_HOSTS = [".example.com", "testserver"]
items.description: Tenant B must not read, list or modify tenant A's objects.

items.title: Isolation test: unauthorised tenant switch
items.body:
def test_user_cannot_switch_tenant(tenants, api_client, user_in_a):
    api_client.force_authenticate(user_in_a)
    r = api_client.get("/api/invoices/", HTTP_HOST="b.example.com")
    assert r.status_code in (403, 404)
items.description: A user of tenant A must not use tenant B by changing the host or header.

items.title: Tenant isolation checklist
items.body:
[ ] Every tenant-owned model inherits the scoped base class
[ ] Raw SQL and .extra() calls filter by tenant
[ ] Admin, management commands and shell use the unscoped manager on purpose
[ ] Cache keys include the tenant id
[ ] File uploads are stored under a per-tenant path
[ ] Background tasks receive the tenant id and set the context
[ ] Search indexes and exports are filtered by tenant
[ ] Unique constraints include the tenant column
[ ] Users can only switch to tenants they belong to
[ ] Logs and error reports include the tenant, never other tenants' data
[ ] Isolation tests exist for list, detail, update and delete

items.title: Row vs schema vs database per tenant
items.body:
Row-level (tenant_id column): simplest, cheapest, scales to many tenants; needs discipline + tests.
Schema per tenant: stronger isolation, per-tenant restore; migrations run per schema.
Database per tenant: strongest isolation and noisy-neighbour control; highest ops cost.
